annotations.text:
The recording block is INGESTION, not capture — the app records nothing.

Verified on the SM-M356B: the Samsung dialer had already written 1863 recordings (3.4 GB). They are unreachable via File APIs but fully indexed in MediaStore, so READ_MEDIA_AUDIO is enough — no all-files access.

35 of 35 connected calls matched on duration + timing. 0 ambiguous.

Call history deliberately shows the awkward rows: an unknown number, a withheld (private) number, and a failed upload.

Sync status adds the matching outcomes — Matched / Needs review / No recording — because an ambiguous match is a human decision, never an automatic one.
Every value is lifted from the Mynt system already shipping in zebu_helpdesk — Inter, #0037B7, 12px cards, 8px inputs, 50px buttons, flat surfaces with 1px outlines. Nothing here invents a new token.
